gen-gf-goldman-gf-amiko: Goldman stretches out wide and bold, its rounds like open parentheses. Amiko tucks in beneath with tall, thick-stroked lowercase and outward-pointing terminals, so the heading gets the shouting and the text gets the talking.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-anek-bangla: Goldman takes the lead with wide, commanding letters and a big lowercase against its capitals. Anek Bangla follows in a friendly sans with a short climb to its ascenders, so a long page would read easily and without strain.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-anek-devanagari: Goldman spreads its bold, parenthesis-round letters wide, while Anek Devanagari sits beneath in a plain sans with distinctly open mouths and a tall middle zone. Its strongest quality is that clear split.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-anek-gujarati: Wide, loud and a bit swaggering: Goldman has round forms like open parentheses and a big lowercase. And Anek Gujarati, a sans whose lowercase nearly rivals its capitals, makes the strongest single quality here the sheer size of its letters.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-anek-gurmukhi: Big open counters fill every small letter in Anek Gurmukhi, a clean sans-serif with generous curves. Goldman is best at wide, commanding display lettering, whereas Anek Gurmukhi is best at holding the text steady underneath.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-anek-kannada: Anek Kannada stands tall, its x-height squared-off like woodblock type. Goldman above it is wide and bold; making the heading small would waste that spread, so give it real size over this plain sans.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-anek-latin: Anek Latin is a modern sans-serif whose tall lowercase nearly reaches the capitals, with letters held open rather than curled shut. Shrink Goldman and its width loses its punch.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-anek-malayalam: Anek Malayalam keeps its lowercase close to cap height, with curve tips that never quite touch. And Goldman's wide, bold forms above it send a long read onward smoothly, in a clean sans-serif.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-anek-odia: Contemporary and clean, with a firm voice up top. Anek Odia keeps its rounds unlatched like hooks and its capitals barely above lowercase, so a long passage in this plain sans would flow without bumps.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-anek-tamil: Goldman is wide, bold and commanding, its round forms like open parentheses. Anek Tamil, a modern sans-serif, does the quieter job with big round bowls and half-unwrapped curves that keep text inviting.
